goldens.comment: logic: Potential nil pointer exception - if no TopicUser record exists, tu will be nil and calling methods on it will crash
goldens.reasoning: C1 describes the same nil TopicUser crash.

goldens.comment: Typo in property name: 'stopNotificiationsText' should be 'stopNotificationsText' (missing 'n' in 'Notifications')

candidates: TopicUser.find_by(...) can return nil if the user has no topic_users row yet, and the subsequent tu.notification_level access will raise, causing 500 errors when hitting the unsubscribe URL

topicUnsubscribe is declared as a top-level route, but the template lives at templates/topic/unsubscribe.hbs (which resolves to topic.unsubscribe), so Ember may not find/render the intended template and the unsubscribe page may render incorrectly or blank
